digest.component_or_area: codebase-wide comment rationalization and taxonomy enforcement
propositions: Six subsystem agents triaged 439 files in src/rebar identifying ~2,033 recoverable comment lines for relocation to taxonomy destinations (history→tickets, architecture→ADRs, contracts→schema).
Self-referential prose explaining the 800-line module cap occupies 28 reconciler sites and must be consolidated into ADR 0062 as a single canonical record.
Three files (_store/event_append.py, reducer/_processors.py, signing.py) carry load-bearing replay-compat and security invariants in comments that cannot be relocated and must be marked DO_NOT_MOVE.

Verified-stale comments found across six sites contradict current code (e.g., DET_CHECKS runs P1-P11 but comments claim P1-P9; Anthropic constraint marked stale in structured.py) and must be corrected in place, not deleted.
Each shard must append its do_not_move list to .joe-janitor/tools.md before landing, and all eight proposed ADRs must be committed before any citing comment is collapsed.
Net recovery across six stacked changes is ~85 lines (measured per-shard diff output), far below the ~2,033 pre-triage estimate due to correction- and relocation-dominance rather than deletion.
